title: Terry Lovelace's phone health data shows six stories climbed in a one-story house

tellings.quote: lel's cell phone Health Data that shows

plain: A man named Terry Lovelace has health data from his cell phone showing that he climbed six storeys one night, though he lives in a one-storey house. John Blitch, a scientist who worked with DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, and who says he was himself abducted by an alien, tells Michels about it as Lovelace related it. The point is that the phone seems to record him being taken somewhere he cannot account for.
